Review this pull request/diff as a maintainer: <PR or diff>

Read the issue/goal and repository instructions first. Judge the change against acceptance criteria, not personal style.

Check:
- behavior/correctness and scope;
- regression/compatibility/migration risk;
- security/privacy/secrets;
- failure handling and recoverability;
- tests and whether they prove the intended behavior;
- docs/config/release notes when user-visible;
- accidental unrelated changes/dead code.

Return findings sorted by severity with concrete file/symbol references and actionable fixes. Explicitly distinguish required changes from suggestions.
